# Irha Apparels

> Experienced B2B custom apparel manufacturer in Sialkot, Pakistan for brands, wholesalers, importers, retailers, sports clubs and private-label buyers. The website is newly built.

Irha Apparels provides OEM, ODM and made-to-requirement apparel programs. The public website is organized around Bavarian and Trachten wear, premium leather apparel, sportswear, streetwear, activewear, leisurewear and nightwear.

The website is for business inquiries rather than consumer retail. Fixed product prices and a universal MOQ are not published. Product feasibility, materials, construction, sampling, quantity, branding, packaging, production timing, shipping and documentation are confirmed after the buyer's requirements are reviewed.

Buyers can collect products from multiple categories into one quotation request, specify target quantity and size breakdown per style, and privately upload PDF, Adobe Illustrator, EPS, ZIP, PNG or JPG tech-pack files. Uploaded files are not public catalogue assets.

Qualified buyers may request a live factory view by video call. Irha Apparels manufactures in Sialkot, Pakistan and does not claim factories or offices in target export markets. Equipment scope and production capacity are confirmed against the actual order rather than presented as an unsupported blanket figure.

## Primary public pages

- [Home](https://irhaapparels.com/): Current B2B manufacturing overview and main buyer actions.
- [Collections](https://irhaapparels.com/products): Published apparel categories and product programs.
- [Catalogue](https://irhaapparels.com/catalogue): Buyer-friendly catalogue groups.
- [Manufacturing](https://irhaapparels.com/manufacturing): Requirement-led manufacturing workflow.
- [Buyer Trust](https://irhaapparels.com/buyer-trust): Verification, communication and buyer confidence information.
- [Factory Video Call](https://irhaapparels.com/factory-video-call): Live factory-view request information.
- [Compliance](https://irhaapparels.com/compliance): Evidence-led compliance and documentation policy.
- [Inquiry](https://irhaapparels.com/inquiry): Quotes, samples, catalogue requests, references and meeting requests.
- [Contact](https://irhaapparels.com/contact): Official email and WhatsApp contact options.
